description: Shared rule config for egy-names. Every SDK should read these values instead of hardcoding them, so a single edit here plus scripts/sync-catalog.sh fixes every language at once. Only pure algorithms (compound-token lookahead, first-personal-token-wins gender/religion, corpus-share tie-break) stay as code per SDK — everything expressible as a threshold or a list lives here.

infer_thresholds._comment: Holdout-measured precision-at-threshold, not guessed. Re-run python/scripts/calibrate_thresholds.py after any retrain and update here.

infer_rules._comment: Ordered rule tables the fallback checks before trusting the ML model. Each rule: script (ar/en), one or more of prefix/suffix/contains (string or list), 'match':'all' requires every listed condition, 'match':'any' (default) requires just one. Then value + confidence.
